summary: Diagnosed and fixed host-side Supabase DB script failures caused by Docker hostname resolution, built a full reset-db script with non-interactive mode, and patched the GitHub Actions deploy workflow to handle stale container name conflicts.
highlights: Fixed reset-numbers.ts and migrate.ts: pool was using DATABASE_URL (supabase-db Docker hostname, unreachable from host) — added pool-script.ts that prefers DATABASE_URL_HOST (127.0.0.1:5433) for scripts run outside Docker
Built reset-db.ts: full wipe (drops all 13 tables in FK-safe order → re-runs all migrations → re-seeds admin/rates/settings); supports non-interactive mode via RESET_CONFIRM and ADMIN_* env vars
Fixed deploy-backend.yml CI/CD: added docker rm -f hisab-backend before docker compose up to clear stale containers that were blocking container name reuse across deploys
